text: Leverage. One frontier brain, an elastic workforce. Your best model stays the strategist; Leverage hires local, free and connected models underneath it, verifies every result, and replaces workers that fail.
RocketRide runs the work. Every cloud worker is a real pipeline, and credit consumption is read from billing, so cost per run is measured. Press "Run one yourself, now" to see it happen.

The one page that is not a recording. Press Run and a real mission starts inside the deployment: a fresh copy of the repository, a fixed goal, a zero-dollar budget, workers on RocketRide through the hosted pool.
A finished mission: status, quality, paid spend $0.00, tasks 4/4, elapsed time. Every figure comes from the append-only event log.

The auction. Thirteen hosted candidates scored on task fit, measured reputation, context headroom and availability. The winner is shown with its reasoning. A paid model under a $0 budget is removed, not ranked lower.
Live execution: the whole event stream, from mission.created to "Mission verified: 4/4 tasks passed". The ProofPack below lists every check with its result.

The cognitive handoff. A worker fails, Leverage writes a checkpoint of what it understood, and a replacement resumes from it. The transcript is not carried. The understanding is. The work does not restart.
Supply, measured. The hosted pool is healthy with thirteen models; RocketRide is healthy with the live credit balance. Host and agent-CLI seats show as unavailable on a server, honestly.
Every model Leverage can reach, each one proven with a real completion before it was allowed on the list. Success rates are shrunk toward a neutral prior and carry a sample count.
Measured, or not claimed. The recorded missions, what RocketRide executed, and a 100-task control-plane test with zero duplicate claims and zero budget overshoots.
The film, narrated, on the landing page. Then open useleverage.vercel.app/app/live and press the button yourself.
